posts.text:
Freedom is not free.

Today we pause to remember the men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for this country. The ones who never came home. The ones who gave everything so we could have everything. May we never take for granted the price paid for our freedom.

God bless our fallen soldiers. 🇺🇸

The SPLC has built an empire claiming to fight hate. Now they’re accused of funneling $3 million into groups tied to the KKK, Neo-Nazis, and white supremacists. All while labeling TPUSA and Moms for Liberty as “hate groups.” Because of the hatred they push, our country has never been more divided. They need to be held accountable.

Video

My father remains on my heart each day. He devoted 28 years to the United States Army, served three combat tours, and earned every commendation save the Medal of Honor. On this eve of Memorial Day, to the men and women who made it home, and especially to those who laid down their lives: we salute your sacrifice. Your legacy endures.

Video
Our hearts are with every Gold Star family this weekend.

The VA spends nearly $1 BILLION a year on software with no tracking system.

Our veterans deserve the best care this country can offer.

We introduced the Veterans Affairs Management and Oversight of Software Assets (VAMOSA) Act to fix it. Under our bill, the VA must maintain a complete inventory of every software asset, eliminate duplication, adopt cost-effective licensing, train employees, and report savings directly to Congress every single year.

Our veterans gave everything. The least we ca

Our constitutional amendment ensures those making decisions for our country are loyal to America and America only. As it should be. It’s common sense.

America FIRST.

America should be run by American patriots.

We've seen time and time again lawmakers who were not born in the United States prove their priorities are not America first. We proposed a constitutional amendment to fix this.

Video

South Carolina families deserve to achieve the American dream.

Our government has had decades to modernize the tax code and make homeownership more accessible. Instead, they let outdated laws sit untouched while families pay the price.

We have a plan. We have the legislation. It's time to give hard-working families a shot.

READ HERE: postandcourier.com/opinion/c…

We introduced the Protect American Fisheries Act to strengthen protections for U.S. fisheries and coastal communities against foreign interference and illegal fishing.

South Carolina's fishing industry is the backbone of our coastal economy and our way of life. For far too long, foreign actors have cheated the system with illegal fishing and forced labor. This bill finally brings real accountability.

We will ALWAYS go to bat for our South Carolina shrimpers and fishermen.

John 15:13: "Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends."

This Memorial Day weekend, we pray for all of our fallen servicemembers. We know there is no greater love for our country than their sacrifice.

Thank you to the brave Secret Service agents who acted swiftly last night to keep President Trump safe and take down the gunman before it escalated any further.

It’s been less than a month since another deranged person attempted to take President Trump’s life at the WHCD, and now this. Two armed attacks in less than 30 days. This is not normal.

Stop the political violence.

The Hilton Head School for the Creative Arts hosted a concert to recognize our veterans and celebrate America's 250th birthday. Every single moment of it was a reminder of just how special this country is and how much we owe the men and women who defended her.

Thank you for a beautiful event.

South Carolina STRONG.

If you're born a man, you use the men's restroom. Women should not have their private spaces invaded.

It is not a controversial stance to not want biological men in our bathrooms, locker rooms, sports, or any space meant for women ONLY. We won't apologize and we won't back down.

Video
Ilhan Omar is about as anti-American as it gets.

There is no place for political violence in America, none. 

Unfortunately, this has become a new normal for our country. We are sick of seeing this. Enough is enough. Political violence is never the answer, no matter who you are or what you believe. 

This has to stop.


New York Post (@nypost)

Some of the most vulnerable people in America are seniors living under guardianship. They depend on their Social Security benefits to survive. And right now, there is no federal system in place to make sure those benefits are going to the right people.

We cosponsored the Senior Guardianship Social Security Protection Act to change it. This bill requires states to notify the Social Security Administration when guardianship arrangements are changed or terminated, so benefits can be redirected app

Pray for President Trump right now.


Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh)
